purpose: Untimed W8 AOT load-compatibility evidence; this document contains no generation-speed result.

classificationPolicy.observed: Directly recorded by the export, compilation, device-load, or host-observation process.
classificationPolicy.inference: An interpretation constrained by the observations and not a controlled causal result.

repeatedAuthoringExports.observedConclusion: The two exports, which used different output directories, were not byte-identical; this check does not isolate the source of the difference.

rebootBoundaryEvidence.qualification: The command result records a full-reboot request and a timeout while waiting for the device. The subsequent inventory records the same device booted and connected before install and launch; this is not an independently instrumented boot transition.

observedSynthesis: The public W8 artifact produced by coreai-build-3600.75.3 failed during ANECCompileOffline in two load-only invocations in the fixed device and OS environment. The second followed a full-reboot request, a timeout while waiting for the device, and a subsequent observation that the same phone was again booted and connected before install and launch.
Both explicit failures reported a nil heap allocation for requests of approximately 651.6 to 651.9 MB and terminated with signal 6 before a terminal diagnostic record was emitted.
The W8 AOT produced by coreai-build-3600.83.1 completed its single load-and-immediate-unload invocation in 41.931619875 seconds, emitted one passing record, and exited with code 0.
The same passing record reported 2737.046875 MiB peak process resident memory and 236.96875 MiB process resident memory after unload.
Two authoring exports made with the same locked inputs and parameters, differing only in output directory, produced different raw main.mlirb hashes and sizes that differed by four bytes.
No compatibility invocation performed generation or contributed a speed sample.

supported: The current-producer AOT identified by compiledMainSHA256 09f609775baa56b11ff3c91bfcb07b145930297289634fdc5514b2a5ab4dc7ca can load and unload in the tested device and OS environment.

The outcome difference between the old public artifact and the current-producer candidate is consistent with an artifact/runtime compatibility boundary and justifies collecting replacement measurements with the loadable candidate.
limitations: The old public artifact and the passing candidate differ in both authoring-model byte identity and compiler producer, so the observations do not isolate either change as causal.

The repeated exports used different output directories and produced different raw bytes. This check does not determine whether the difference arose from path metadata or another source; a main.mlirb hash mismatch alone therefore does not establish a recipe, weight, graph-structure, or numerical mismatch.
There is no controlled same-artifact comparison across operating-system builds, no compiler-by-operating-system matrix, and only one load invocation of the current-producer candidate.
A nil heap-allocation assertion records the immediate failure mechanism but does not establish that system-wide physical memory was insufficient.
The measured load duration is a diagnostic field and must not be reported as a generation-speed sample.
notSupported: A causal claim that an operating-system upgrade produced the old-artifact failures
A causal claim that changing only the Core AI compiler producer restored compatibility
A claim that every artifact produced by coreai-build-3600.75.3 is incompatible with iOS build 24A5424a
A claim that total device memory was insufficient
A claim that the passing candidate is byte-identical to the historical public authoring model

checksumFieldSemantics.sourceHashSHA256: SHA-256 identity of the authoring-model main.mlirb recorded by the AOT metadata; it is not the digest of the compiled main file.
checksumFieldSemantics.compiledMainSHA256: SHA-256 of the compiled .aimodelc main-h16p.mlirb; the candidate main.hash contained the same digest bytes.
checksumFieldSemantics.artifactManifestSHA256: SHA-256 of the benchmark artifact manifest that enumerates artifact files, sizes, and per-file hashes; it is not a whole-directory byte digest.
checksumFieldSemantics.completeArtifactFileListFingerprintSHA25: Reported SHA-256 fingerprint of the complete AOT directory file list and its file identities; it is distinct from compiledMainSHA256.
checksumFieldSemantics.appliedPatchSHA256: SHA-256 of the patch applied to the locked Apple coreai-models source tree.
checksumFieldSemantics.frozenRecipeSHA256: SHA-256 of the exact frozen export recipe.

sanitization.statement: The public event-level evidence omits unique device identifiers, device nicknames, serial numbers, ECIDs, UDIDs, network addresses, application-container paths, process identifiers, audit tokens, signing-team identifiers, signing identities, private Apple developer-account identifiers, and absolute wall-clock timestamps.

publicEventEvidence.originalCaptures: retained privately because they contain persistent device identifiers and ephemeral application paths; the sourceEvidenceDigests values identify those retained originals but do not independently prove the manual extraction mapping
